calibration_gaps: Control-plane identity only; no events or target delivery are exercised.
Default bus itself is shared and never mutated or deleted; only the exact preverified unique rule is owned.
Public stack events do not expose private CloudFormation API ordering or ownership tokens.

cleanup.boundary: Exact owned names verified absent; deleted stack ARN retains DELETE_COMPLETE history

EventBusName.description: The name or ARN of the event bus associated with the rule. If you omit this, the default event bus is used.

EventPattern.description: The event pattern of the rule. For more information, see Events and Event Patterns in the Amazon EventBridge User Guide.

ScheduleExpression.description: The scheduling expression. For example, "cron(0 20 * * ? *)", "rate(5 minutes)". For more information, see Creating an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs on a schedule.

Targets.description:
Adds the specified targets to the specified rule, or updates the targets if they are already associated with the rule.
Targets are the resources that are invoked when a rule is triggered.

Arn.description: The ARN of the rule, such as arn:aws:events:us-east-2:123456789012:rule/example.

RoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role that is used for target invocation.

RuleName.description: The name of the rule, exposed as a read-only attribute for use with Fn::GetAtt.

Tags.description: Any tags assigned to the event rule.
